# What this can do

<!-- generated by scripts/skills_sync.py --capabilities. Do not hand-edit. -->

Generated from the 95 skills installed here.

Nothing on this page is maintained by hand, so it cannot claim a capability that is not installed or miss one that is. If a skill is here, it is on your disk. Say the thing in plain language; the slash command in brackets is the shortcut, not the requirement.

Regenerate after adding or removing a skill:

```
python scripts/skills_sync.py --capabilities
```

## Your day

- **today** - Show today's one-screen brief: anchor task, open decisions, open flags, last 3 log entries, and next event
- **morning-loop** - The morning answer loop
- **queue** - Manage the work queue
- **priority-triage** - Cut through overwhelm to ONE thing to do next
- **weekly-review** - Run the weekly review and roll the sprint
- **since-last-session** - Report what changed in the OS since the last time this skill ran
- **menu** - Show what FounderOS can do right now
- **founder-next-move** - Propose the single highest-leverage next move

## Your brain

- **brain-log** - Capture a thought, flag, or decision into the brain system
- **brain-pass** - Synthesise an answer across the brain layer
- **catch-up** - Sweep everything captured away from the laptop into the brain
- **knowledge-capture** - Capture takeaways from a book, podcast, article, or conversation
- **ingest** - File a source (URL, file path, or pasted text) into raw/ with provenance preserved
- **query** - Search across the OS with a multi-hop query
- **cross-link** - Propose [[wikilink]] insertions for backtick-quoted paths and unquoted prose path mentions in a single markdown file
- **wiki-build** - Rebuild the wiki graph from extracted [[wikilinks]]
- **lint** - Audit the wiki for integrity issues
- **log-archive** - Age the running brain log so a long-lived install stays lean
- **memory-pass** - Use when memory entries may be stale - after a 7+ day session gap, after a close, block, or unblock event, or when a person or project mentioned in conversation contradicts an existing memory claim
- **observation-rollup** - Compresses observation logs into weekly summaries
- **history** - Show the founder their saved versions as readable dated events, wrapping git log so they never read a SHA

## Writing in your voice

- **your-voice** - Apply the founder's writing voice to any text
- **voice-interview** - Set up the writing-voice profile
- **brand-interview** - Set up the visual brand profile
- **linkedin-post** - Write a LinkedIn post in the founder's voice
- **email-drafter** - Draft an email in the founder's voice
- **client-update** - Write a status update or milestone report for whoever is waiting on the work - a client, or the person you answer to inside a company
- **content-repurposer** - Reformat one piece of content across many channels
- **proposal-writer** - Write a consulting or service proposal
- **sop-writer** - Write a delegation-ready SOP
- **your-deliverable-template** - Build a branded document inheriting the founder's colors, fonts, and logo
- **brand-voice-interview** - Capture a brand's writing voice and positioning

## Customers and pipeline

- **prospect-init** - Create a new prospect record for a company you sell to or watch
- **meeting-prep** - Prep for a meeting or debrief one after
- **pipeline-start** - The front door to the Pipeline pack: turn a name into a tracked, worked deal
- **reconnect-prompt** - Turn an expired-token or 401 failure into one copy-paste reconnect prompt and log the failed call
- **linkedin-network-scan** - Turn your own LinkedIn export into a ranked, ready-to-work outreach list, for free
- **linkedin-power-audit** - Deep, deterministic read of your own LinkedIn data export - far more than the connection scan
- **linkedin-warm-revival** - Surface the dormant-but-valuable contacts you have not spoken to in months, each with a one-line reopener
- **linkedin-brand-direction** - Turn your real LinkedIn network plus your goal into a personalised, algorithm-aware content direction
- **review-responder** - Draft replies to incoming customer messages, reviews, DMs, and inquiries

## Thinking it through

- **decision-framework** - Walk through a structured decision when the founder is stuck
- **strategic-analysis** - Run a strategic analysis: competitive map, market sizing, opportunity, or business model
- **bottleneck-diagnostic** - Find the real bottleneck in the business
- **unit-economics** - Run business math: unit economics, pricing, CAC, LTV, margins, break-even
- **founder-coaching** - Coach a founder through their state and capacity
- **forcing-questions** - Pressure-test a new initiative before starting it
- **founder-scope-challenge** - Stress-test a founder's plan, brutally, before they spend weeks on it
- **blind-spot-review** - Pressure-test a draft for blind spots before pre-send review
- **what-to-change** - The flagship routine
- **strategic-read** - Produce a state-of-the-OS report from the current file layer

## Your team of roles

- **employee-review** - Review one digital employee and propose changes to it
- **profile-router** - Decide who is operating the OS and what it should lead with for them
- **routines** - Discover, trigger, and understand your routines in plain English

## Keeping it healthy

- **verify** - Check that Founder OS is healthy
- **audit** - Audit the OS in one composite report
- **housekeeping** - One periodic maintenance sweep that keeps a months-old brain from rotting
- **readiness-check** - Score the OS install across six buckets and name the next 3 moves
- **os-evolve** - Turn an audit, a pile of flags, or a vague sense that the OS is drifting into one dated plan with numbered execute prompts
- **founder-review** - Your own monthly performance review, run by your OS
- **skill-creator** - Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance
- **backup** - Back up the founder's OS to a destination they choose, on command only
- **restore** - Undo the founder's OS back to an earlier saved version, non-destructively, wrapping git so they never type a git command
- **save** - Save the founder's work as a new version, wrapping git so they never type a git command
- **own-your-history** - Turn on full version history for a Founder OS install that does not have it yet - the graduation step for ZIP installs
- **session-handoff** - Package this session for a fresh chat
- **connect** - Connect a tool to Founder OS by asking in plain English
- **tune** - Tune your voice handlers to how you actually talk

## Before anything leaves your machine

- **pre-send-check** - Run a pre-send gate before any deliverable goes out
- **ship-deliverable** - Run the final ship gate before any external deliverable goes out
- **approval-gates** - Check whether an action needs approval before doing it
- **data-security** - Check whether data is safe to share with an external tool
